dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: Isn't the continued growth of the Akademiya dependent on the education of future scholars?

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: If we wait until there are no successors left, it will be too late already. We can't actually bring in researchers from the Nagarjunites, right?

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: The Akademiya recently cut back on the budget for education, and that rubbed me the wrong way.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: To better advance research and development, the Akademiya would recruit talented children at an early age.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: I'm the teacher for those children. Seeing them mature into accomplished researchers gives me immense pride.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: But if the Akademiya keeps shaving the budget, it will impact their education.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: Even from the point of maintaining our prestige, I still don't think it's right.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: Farewell. Someone has to speak out about this.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: The Nagarjunites were a branch of the Akademiya from long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: They were said to advocate strange ideals like "the transmission of knowledge at all costs" and "conflict is the natural order of Teyvat."

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: In short, this school of thought has long broken away from the rest of the Akademiya. They're no longer on the same branch.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: Although they still seem to exist deep in the desert, most people have either never heard of them, or have, but consider them a myth.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: I'm just being angry, so don't take it too seriously. I believe that sooner or later the Akademiya will take the future of our children seriously...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you come up with any solution?

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: I will have to speak out if the Akademiya continues to cut funding.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: I've talked to Vikram. He also believes it's what has to be done to ensure the learning conditions for the children.
